subject: Just released an AnyChart JS integration template for data visualization with R, Shiny and MySQL

messages.author: fa85a43152842942
messages.subject: Just released an AnyChart JS integration template for data visualization with R, Shiny and MySQL
parts:
Hi all,

We at AnyChart JS Charts have just released a series of 20+ integration templates to help developers add interactive charts and maps (and dashboards) to web apps faster with popular technology stacks.

In particular, a template for R, Shiny and MySQL is now available in the Technical Integrations collection, distributed under the Apache 2.0 license and forkable on GitHub.

Check that out, and ask your questions if any. Thanks.
